text: dsh-editor-context 将 Cursor 或 VS Code 当前查看的文件位置和行范围带入 DSH web 对话草稿。它在输入框的 @ 菜单提供当前编辑器位置，用户可选中后插入带行号的引用 chip；也可从编辑器点击 Add to Bot，把位置送到草稿。插件读取编辑器扩展发布的本机状态，通过 WebSocket 接收推送，并经 DSH 的同源 HTTP 路由交给浏览器界面。引用保留完整路径和行范围，发送时模型收到对应 token。适合希望在提问时指明正在查看的代码位置的开发者；需要配套 Editor Context 扩展和 DSH web profile。

dsh-editor-context brings the current Cursor or VS Code file position into a DSH web draft. Pick it from the @ menu or use Add to Bot; DSH inserts a reference chip with its line range. The plugin relays editor updates to the browser and requires the companion Editor Context extension.
想把编辑器里正在看的代码行引用到 DSH 问题里。
怎样让 Cursor 里的当前文件位置出现在 DSH 输入框？
I want to point DSH to the lines open in my code editor.
dsh-editor-context 的功能「@ 菜单插入编辑器位置」：在 DSH 输入框输入 @ 后，菜单显示当前编辑器文件及行范围；选择候选项会把带路径和行号的引用 chip 插入草稿。
dsh-editor-context 的功能「从编辑器发送位置」：在配套扩展中使用 Add to Bot，编辑器通过 WebSocket 推送当前代码位置，插件经长轮询交给浏览器，并插入当前会话草稿。

dsh-editor-context README · dsh-editor-context：> **[English](README.md) · [中文](README.zh-CN.md)**

Turn the lines you are looking at in Cursor / VS Code into a chip in the DSH
composer.

Type `@`, pick **editor position**, and a chip lands in your draft. Send it, and
the model receives the file and the range:

```
@/data/project/qihuan/hallsrv/internal/logic/logic_purchase/limit.go#L146-L154
```

dsh-editor-context README · dsh-editor-context：That is the whole feature. The position reaches the conversation because you put
it in your own sentence — nothing is injected behind you — so there is no
numbering to disambiguate, no auto-injection to switch off, and nothing to
configure. A reference you typed needs none of that.

dsh-editor-context README · What you need：- DSH 0.2.x, running the web profile (`dsh web`) — verified on `0.2.2-alpha.2`
- The editor half: **Editor Context**, `pandarayc.editor-context-bridge` on the
  [Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=pandarayc.editor-context-bridge),
  0.5.0 or newer. It publishes `~/.editor-context/windows/*.json` and announces
  the WebSocket this plugin dials in `~/.editor-context/endpoints/`.

dsh-editor-context README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:pandarayc/dsh-editor-context
dsh-editor-context README · or a local checkout:：dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-editor-context

dsh-editor-context README · then restart dsh-web — plugins load at process start：```

The package is not on npm yet, so `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-editor-context`
does not resolve; use the repository form above until it does.
section: then restart dsh-web — plugins load at process start

text:
dsh-editor-context README · Use：In the composer, type `@`. An **editor position** group appears with one row —
where you are right now:

```
@
├─ editor position
│    limit.go:146-154        hallsrv/internal/logic/…/limit.go
└─ reference

Picking it puts a chip in your draft as a word in your sentence. Type around it,
edit it, delete it, never send it: it is ordinary draft text, and it stays a chip
in replayed history too.

dsh-editor-context README · Use：The chip is short (`limit.go:146-154`), but the model receives the full token.
The send path expands every reference through its owner's codec before it goes
out, so the model sees an address it can open, not a label.

| You insert | The model receives |
|---|---|
| `@<absolute path>#L146` | the caret is on line 146 |
| `@<absolute path>#L146-L154` | lines 146-154 are selected |

dsh-editor-context README · Use：**The absolute path is what the model gets**, because `relativePath` in the state
file is relative to the *editor's* workspace root, which is generally not the
agent's working directory — `read` could not open it.

dsh-editor-context README · Use：**Why `#L`.** DSH's shipped file rule treats everything after `@` up to
whitespace as a path, so `@path:12-34` would have the colon swallowed into the
path and two rules claiming the same span. `#` is outside that grammar, so this
token's ownership is unambiguous — and `#L` is the line-address spelling models
already know from web forges.

dsh-editor-context README · From the editor, without switching windows：The same position can be sent from Cursor / VS Code instead of typed here:
**Add to Bot** on the editor title bar. The chip appears in your draft the moment
you click, so you can point at three places in a row and then ask one question
about all three.

```
Cursor: Add to Bot on limit.go:146-154
   ↓  the extension pushes a delivery frame over its WebSocket
   ↓  this plugin is dialled in and receives it in the same tick
   ↓  your open tab holds a parked long poll; it wakes and inserts
section: From the editor, without switching windows

text:
dsh-editor-context README · From the editor, without switching windows：The extension runs the WebSocket **server** and this plugin is the **client**.
That direction is not arbitrary: Node ships a WebSocket client and no server, so
the half that needs a library is the one living in a VSIX — which is why this
plugin still has no dependencies at all.
section: From the editor, without switching windows

text:
dsh-editor-context README · From the editor, without switching windows：One extension window is one server, and a port only one process can hold, so the
extension announces where each window actually ended up in
`~/.editor-context/endpoints/<pid>.json`. The plugin reads that directory and
keeps **one link per window** — a second window, a restarted extension or a
changed port all look the same from here: the next scan sees a different
directory than the last one. `wsUrl` is still dialled when the registry is empty,
which is what a pre-0.5 extension looks like.
section: From the editor, without switching windows

text:
dsh-editor-context README · From the editor, without switching windows：Neither hop is an interval. The editor pushes; the plugin's long poll parks until
there is something to hand the browser. An idle conversation is one open socket
and one parked response, not a request per second.

The delivery carries the **text** as well as the address and the range. A delivery
is a snapshot, not a pointer: a pointer goes stale the moment the file is edited,
moved or reverted, and the agent is then reasoning about code that no longer
exists.
section: From the editor, without switching windows

text:
dsh-editor-context README · Configuration：```yaml
- id: editor-context
  name: dsh-editor-context
  config:
    # wsUrl: "ws://127.0.0.1:7788/editor-context"   # the editor extension's publisher

dsh-editor-context README · Configuration：`wsUrl` is the **fallback**, not the address: with extension 0.5.0 or newer the
real endpoint comes from the registry, and this is only dialled when the registry
is empty. If the extension sets a token, this side needs the same string or the
publisher refuses the subscription — and a refusal is terminal, reported once,
because a wrong secret is still wrong thirty seconds later.

dsh-editor-context README · Configuration：The plugin mounts a read-only `GET /editor-context/position` on DSH's web server,
which the browser half reads. It returns an address and a line range — never file
contents. A path the extension's `excludeGlobs` rejected answers 404, so the
exclusion rule does not leak the path it is hiding.

dsh-editor-context README · `/editors`：Typing `/editors` in a conversation opens a picker of the **editor windows this
plugin is talking to** — app name, project folder, state and pid. Picking one
inserts *that* window's current position into the draft, which is the DSH-side
equivalent of going back to the editor and pressing Add to Bot.

dsh-editor-context README · `/editors`：It is a picker rather than a status dump because the question behind it is
"which Cursor am I pointing at", and with two windows open that has no single
answer. It is named `editors` and not `status`: `status` describes a whole
process, and a keyword nobody can guess is a failure of its own.

dsh-editor-context README · `/editors`：The same data is on `GET /editor-context/editors`, one entry per link with its
state (`absent`, `connecting`, `ready`, `refused`), dial count, and the `hello`
the window sent. It says nothing about files, and it exists because the
interesting failure is silence: a plugin with no socket looks exactly like a user
who has not pressed anything.

dsh-editor-context README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | What to check |
|---|---|
| `@` shows no **editor position** row | `cat ~/.editor-context/windows/*.json` — no file means the extension is not installed or not activated |
| …the row is there but stale | the position is older than `maxAgeSeconds`; move the caret in the editor |
| …the row is missing only in some files | the path matches `editorContext.excludeGlobs` on the extension side. That is by design: not even the path is published |
| nothing happens at all | `/editors` in a conversation, or `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3080/editor-context/editors` — no rows means no editor is linked; a `refused` state names why |
| …`/editors` is missing from the menu | the plugin did not mount, or `http: false`; `~/.editor-context/plugin.log` says which |

dsh-editor-context README · Limitations：- **A path containing spaces needs the quoted form**, `@"a b.go"#L12`. The rule
  parses it; the candidate list does not yet produce it.
- **Clicking a chip does not jump back to the editor.** The extension only writes
  files and has no inbound channel.
- **Exclusion is configured on the extension side**, not here. The plugin has no
  rules of its own, and none are needed: it can only offer what the extension
  chose to publish.

dsh-editor-context README · Layout：```
lib/state.js       the position document: one schema, one parser
lib/registry.js    host: which editor windows are announcing an endpoint, and where
lib/link.js        host: one subscriber per window, reconciled against the registry
lib/subscribe.js   host: the WebSocket client that dials one editor window

dsh-editor-context README · Layout：This is a **dual-face package**: the host half runs in the DSH process, the
browser half is handed to the page by DSH's client module system through the
`dsh.client` declaration. The browser half is hand-written with no build step and
imports only `react`; cross-package reach is always through cordis services
(`ctx.inputTriggers` / `ctx.uiConversation` / `ctx.slots`).

```bash
npm test    # 82 passed
```

dsh-editor-context README · Layout：Seven files: `test/editor-context.test.mjs` (the reader, the config, and what
`apply` registers), `test/http.test.mjs` (all three routes and the browser
payload), `test/deliveries.test.mjs` (the queue), `test/subscribe.test.mjs` (the
socket client, against a socket double), `test/registry.test.mjs` and
`test/link.test.mjs` (discovery and membership), and `test/client.test.mjs`, which loads the
**real** bundle behind a fake `window.__ModuleLoader__` and asserts on the bytes
that ship.

dsh-editor-context README · Layout：For why this plugin cannot put anything into a conversation, what it used to do
instead, and the three sharp edges in the client half:
[docs/internals.md](docs/internals.md).

dsh-editor-context README · dsh-editor-context：> **[English](README.md) · [中文](README.zh-CN.md)**

把「你正在 Cursor / VS Code 里看的那几行」变成 DSH 输入框里的一张 chip。

在输入框打 `@`，选**编辑器位置**，chip 落进你的草稿。发出去，模型收到文件与行区间：

```
@/data/project/qihuan/hallsrv/internal/logic/logic_purchase/limit.go#L146-L154
```

这就是全部功能。位置之所以进入对话，是因为**你把它写进了自己的句子**——没有任何
东西在你背后注入——所以不需要编号去区分，不需要开关去关闭自动注入，也没有任何配置。
你自己打出来的引用，不需要这些。

dsh-editor-context README · 前置：- DSH 0.2.x，跑 web profile（`dsh web`）——在 `0.2.2-alpha.2` 上验证
- 编辑器半边：**Editor Context**，市场里的 `pandarayc.editor-context-bridge`
  （[链接](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=pandarayc.editor-context-bridge)），
  0.5.0 以上。它负责写 `~/.editor-context/windows/*.json`，并在
  `~/.editor-context/endpoints/` 里公布本插件要拨的 WebSocket。

dsh-editor-context README · 安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:pandarayc/dsh-editor-context
dsh-editor-context README · 或者用本地检出：：dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-editor-context

dsh-editor-context README · 然后重启 dsh-web —— 插件在进程启动时加载：```

text:
dsh-editor-context README · 用法：在输入框打 `@`，菜单里会多一组**编辑器位置**，只有一行——你现在在哪：

```
@
├─ 编辑器位置
│    limit.go:146-154        hallsrv/internal/logic/…/limit.go
└─ reference

选中后 chip 落进草稿，是你句子的一个词：可以放在句子中间、可以改、可以删、可以不发
——它就是普通的草稿文本。回放历史里它同样是 chip。

chip 显示的是短标签（`limit.go:146-154`），但模型收到的是完整 token：发送前每个引用
都会经其属主的 codec 展开，所以模型拿到的是能直接打开的地址，不是一个标签。

| 你插入的 | 模型收到的 |
|---|---|
| `@<绝对路径>#L146` | 光标停在第 146 行 |
| `@<绝对路径>#L146-L154` | 选中了 146-154 行 |

**模型拿到的是绝对路径**：状态文件里的 `relativePath` 相对于**编辑器工作区**，和 agent
的工作目录通常不是一回事，`read` 打不开。

dsh-editor-context README · 用法：**为什么用 `#L`**：DSH 自带的文件规则把 `@` 后面到空白之前的一切当作路径，所以
`@path:12-34` 会被它连冒号一起吞进路径，变成两条规则争同一段文本。`#` 不在那个语法
里，这个 token 的归属因此是明确的；而 `#L` 又是模型从代码托管平台早就熟悉的行号写法。

dsh-editor-context README · 从编辑器直接发，不用切窗口：同一个位置也可以在 Cursor / VS Code 里送出来：编辑器标题栏上的 **Add to Bot**。
点下去 chip 就出现在你的草稿里，所以你可以连着指三处，然后用一句话一起问。

```
Cursor：在 limit.go:146-154 上点 Add to Bot
   ↓  扩展通过自己的 WebSocket 推一帧 delivery
   ↓  本插件已经连着，同一 tick 收到
   ↓  你打开的标签页上挂着一个 parked 长轮询，它醒来并插入

扩展是 WebSocket **服务端**，本插件是**客户端**。这个方向不是随便定的：Node 自带
WebSocket 客户端但不带服务端，所以需要依赖的那一半正好是住在 VSIX 里的扩展——这也是
本插件至今**一个依赖都没有**的原因。

两跳都不是定时器。编辑器推送；插件的长轮询一直挂着，直到有东西要交给浏览器。空闲会话
是一个打开的 socket 加一个挂起的响应，不是每秒一次请求。
section: 从编辑器直接发，不用切窗口

text:
dsh-editor-context README · 从编辑器直接发，不用切窗口：投递里除了地址和行区间**还带文本**。投递是快照不是指针：指针在文件被编辑、移动、回滚的
那一刻就失效了，然后 agent 在推理已经不存在的代码。
section: 从编辑器直接发，不用切窗口

text:
dsh-editor-context README · 配置：```yaml
- id: editor-context
  name: dsh-editor-context
  config:
    # stateDir: "~/.editor-context"   # 编辑器扩展发布状态的目录

插件在 DSH 的 web server 上挂三条只读路由——`GET /editor-context/position`（当前读数）、
`GET /editor-context/next`（长轮询）、`GET /editor-context/editors`（连上了哪些编辑器窗口），
浏览器半边靠它们拿读数。返回的是地址与行区间，**不含文件内容**。被扩展 `excludeGlobs`
排除的路径返回 404——排除规则不会泄露它本想藏起来的那个路径。

这些路由在 DSH 的 SPA 兜底之前匹配，因此**不额外鉴权**。它的定位是本机（默认如此）；
`http: false` 可以整个去掉。

dsh-editor-context README · 排查：| 现象 | 查什么 |
|---|---|
| 打 `@` 没有**编辑器位置**这一组 | `cat ~/.editor-context/windows/*.json`——没有文件说明扩展没装或没激活 |
| 有这一行，但位置是旧的 | 读数超过了 `maxAgeSeconds`；在编辑器里动一下光标 |
| 某些文件里没有这一行 | 命中扩展侧的 `editorContext.excludeGlobs`。这是有意为之：连路径都不发布 |
| 完全没反应 | `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3080/editor-context/editors`——没有行说明没有编辑器连上；`refused` 状态会写明原因 |

dsh-editor-context README · 已知限制：- **路径含空格需要引号形式**：`@"a b.go"#L12`。解析规则支持，候选列表目前还产不出这个形态。
- **点 chip 不会跳回编辑器。** 编辑器扩展只写文件，没有反向通道。
- **排除规则在扩展侧配置**，不在这里。插件自己没有任何规则，也不需要：它只能提供扩展
  愿意发布的东西。

dsh-editor-context README · 目录：```
lib/state.js       位置文档：一套 schema，一个解析器
lib/registry.js    host：哪些编辑器窗口在公布端点、在哪
lib/link.js        host：每个窗口一个订阅者，按 registry 对账
lib/subscribe.js   host：拨通某个编辑器窗口的 WebSocket 客户端

这是**双面包**：host 半边跑在 DSH 进程里，浏览器半边由 DSH 的 client module 系统按
`dsh.client` 声明喂给页面。浏览器半边是手写的、没有构建步骤，只 `import` 了 `react`；
跨包一律走 cordis service（`ctx.inputTriggers` / `ctx.uiConversation` / `ctx.slots`）。

```bash
npm test    # 82 passed
```

dsh-editor-context README · 目录：七个文件：`test/editor-context.test.mjs`（读取端、配置、`apply` 到底注册了什么）、
`test/http.test.mjs`（三条路由与浏览器载荷）、`test/deliveries.test.mjs`（队列）、
`test/subscribe.test.mjs`（socket 客户端，对着假 socket）、`test/registry.test.mjs` 与
`test/link.test.mjs`（发现与成员对账）、`test/client.test.mjs`（**加载真实 bundle**，
用假的 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 与 `require`，断言的是要发出去的字节）。

关于「为什么这个插件不可能往对话里塞东西」「它以前塞过什么」，以及客户端那三个容易
踩的点：[docs/internals.md](docs/internals.md)。
